title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
lineage: SBD MR > Cass >DAT > CD + AUD patch from low-gen cassette

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with variable clarity but a stellar acoustic Rider and strong electric set featuring Black Peter, New Speedway and Pigpen
ai_review.review: The show shines especially on the rare acoustic "Know You Rider" – many call it the most spiritual version – and delivers classic electric moments like Black Peter, New Speedway, Pigpen, Hard to Handle and Man’s World. The soundboard source is uneven, with patches and occasional drop‑outs, yet the latter half sounds clear enough to enjoy the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise the musical performance (especially the acoustic Rider and several electric gems) while noting mixed but improving recording quality, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality fluctuates; early parts have audio patches and occasional drop‑outs, later sections are clearer. Overall listenable but not consistently crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens with a transcendent Rider, then the band builds momentum into an electric second half that "picks up steam" and delivers several classic jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice comes through clearly on Black Peter; guitar tone praised in acoustic Rider.
